title: base_for follows the whole fix chain: a fix round cuts from the newest existing task branch in its fix_round_for lineage, falling back to the goal branch, never origin/main for a task with a parent
spec:
Goal T-1403, wave 2, plan label B7. Evidence: plan.md backlog 2026-09-24 (fix round T-0222 cut from goal/T-0201
before the Planner could base it on the held task) and 2026-09-25 (`orchestrator merge <fix-round>` stamps only
that task); a fix round of a fix round whose direct parent branch was deleted (worktree cleanup, C5b later)
falls through to the goal branch and loses the earlier round's commits.

Facts (goal/T-1403 at 92c1a98):
- spawn.py:277-308 base_for(task): execute + constraints.fix_round_for -> task/<fix_round_for> only when that
  single branch exists (301-303); otherwise goal/<parent> when it exists (304-305); else 'origin/main' (306).
- spawn.py:309-330 ensure_worktree(task_id, base=None): base = base_for(bus.get(task_id)); a base that does not
  rev-parse becomes 'HEAD' (321-322).
- daemon.root(t) / lineage(t) (grep 'def root' and 'def lineage' in daemon.py) walk fix_round_for; spawn must
  not import daemon: re-implement the walk locally with bus.get, bounded to 20 hops and cycle-safe.

Change:
1. spawn.base_for: for an execute task with constraints.fix_round_for, walk the chain fix_round_for ->
   fix_round_for ... (bounded, cycle-safe, missing task ids skipped) and return the first task/<id> branch that
   exists, nearest ancestor first; when none exists fall back to goal/<parent> when it exists; for a task with a
   parent whose goal branch does not exist, return 'origin/main' as today. Record the choice:
   spawn.base_choice(task) -> {'base': branch, 'via': 'fix_chain' | 'goal' | 'trunk', 'chain': [ids walked]};
   base_for returns base_choice(task)['base'].
2. ensure_worktree: when it cuts a new worktree, bus.update(task_id, pipeline={**pipeline, 'worktree_base':
   base_choice}) so the daemon and reviews can see where a worktree came from (one write, under bus.locked()).

Tests that assert the old behaviour (SPEC RULE): tests/test_spawn.py base_for tests (grep 'base_for' and
'fix_round_for'): the single-hop case keeps passing; add the multi-hop and missing-branch cases. Run
tests/test_spawn.py.

Depends on B4v2 T-1453 (spawn.py chain). Out of scope: daemon.py (B6), merge.py.

Work on the task branch cut from goal/T-1403. Commit first, then run the focused tests in the foreground; never
background a command and never run the full gate. Write tests as unittest.TestCase methods using tests/_harness.py
like the neighbouring tests.

Re-filed 2026-10-01 (replaces T-1457): depends_on re-pointed to T-1468 after the B2v3/B4v3 respecs; the spec, acceptance and scope are unchanged.
acceptance: tests/test_spawn.py::test_base_for_follows_fix_chain_to_nearest_existing_branch: passes: for fix round C (fix_round_for B, B fix_round_for A) base_for returns task/B when it exists, task/A when only A's branch exists, goal/<parent> when neither exists and the goal branch does, and 'origin/main' when there is no goal branch; a cycle or a missing task id in the chain does not raise; base_choice reports via and the chain walked
tests/test_spawn.py::test_ensure_worktree_records_worktree_base: passes: ensure_worktree for a fresh fix-round worktree stores pipeline.worktree_base with base and via on the task
